# OpenAtlas — full catalog

Curated directory of 431 free APIs and open datasets (MIT license).
Fields per entry: category, type, pricing, access, limitation, verified date, canonical page, original source.

## Open-Meteo

Global weather forecasts, historical climate data, and air quality. Built for your next weather-powered project.

- Category: Weather & Climate
- Type: API | Pricing: Free | Access: No key
- Limitation: Free for non-commercial use; usage limits apply.
- License stated at source: yes
- Verified: undefined
- OpenAtlas page: https://michaels1011.github.io/openatlasmap/resources/open-meteo
- Original source: https://open-meteo.com/

- Category: Oceans & Water
- Type: API | Pricing: Free | Access: No key
- Limitation: Data windows depend on interval: 1-minute observations allow 4 days per request, 6-minute observations 1 month, and hourly observations 1 year. Heavy query volumes may be throttled.

- Verified: undefined

Live and historical Major League Baseball schedules, box scores, roster and stat endpoints operated by MLB Advanced Media, returning JSON.

- Category: Sports & Games
- Type: API | Pricing: Free | Access: No key
- Limitation: Unofficial public interface with no documented SLA and subject to change; all content is copyrighted by MLB Advanced Media, restricting redistribution.

REST API over the community science biodiversity platform: observations, taxa, places and quality-graded species occurrence records worldwide.

- Category: Biology & Genomics
- Type: API | Pricing: Free | Access: No key
- Limitation: Anonymous requests are rate-limited and writes require a user token; observation data are shared under Creative Commons non-commercial licenses depending on the observer's choice.

Community project of cross-linguistically consistent treebank annotations: around 200 treebanks covering more than 150 languages in CoNLL-U format.

- Category: Language & Linguistics
- Type: Dataset | Pricing: Free | Access: No key
- Limitation: Each treebank is released under its own Creative Commons license (mostly CC BY-SA) and must be cited per its own publication; annotation quality varies by language.

## NIST Chemistry WebBook (SRD 69)

Reference data for chemical species: thermochemistry, phase change, reaction kinetics and IR/MS spectra for tens of thousands of compounds.

- Category: Chemistry & Materials
- Type: Dataset | Pricing: Free | Access: No key
- Limitation: Open access under the NIST Standard Reference Data policy, but some entries carry original-literature copyright; NIST reserves the right to charge for some SRD products and citation of SRD 69 is requested.
- License stated at source: yes

- Original source: https://webbook.nist.gov/chemistry/

## OpenWeather Weather API

Current weather, forecasts and historical data for any location worldwide via JSON APIs from the London-based OpenWeather (since 2012).

- Category: Weather & Climate
- Type: API | Pricing: Free tier | Access: API key
- Limitation: The free subscription requires a free API key and caps calls (around 60 per minute / 1,000 per day) on a limited product set; granular historical and advanced products need paid plans.
- License stated at source: yes
- Verified: 2026-11-19
- OpenAtlas page: https://michaels1011.github.io/openatlasmap/resources/openweather-api
- Original source: https://openweathermap.org/
